definitions.explanation: A very old woman. The word is neutral to literary in tone and often appears in narratives, folklore, and descriptive writing. Not typically used as a direct form of address.

examples.japanese: {老婆|ろうば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：28126_michibata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}っていた→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: An old woman was sitting by the roadside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧{老婆|ろうば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Old women in folk tales often possess mysterious powers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{曲|ま}がった→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧{老婆|ろうば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{杖|つえ}→杖：12862_tsue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つき⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: A stooped old woman was walking slowly, leaning on a cane.

notes:
USAGE: {老婆|ろうば} is a literary or descriptive term. It is not considered polite to use it when speaking directly to or about a specific elderly person you know — use お{婆|ばあ}さん or ⟦{年配|ねんぱい}→年配：10432_nenpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧ instead.

The compound ⟦{老婆心|ろうばしん}→老婆心：21691_roubashin⟧ means "excessive concern" or "well-meaning meddlesomeness" (literally "old woman's heart"), and is used as a humble way of excusing unsolicited advice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{老婆心|ろうばしん}→老婆心：21691_roubashin⟧: well-meaning meddlesomeness
- ⟦{老婆心|ろうばしん}→老婆心：21691_roubashin⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: if I may be so presumptuous (humble)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {老婆|ろうば}: old woman (literary/descriptive)
- お{婆|ばあ}さん: grandmother; old woman (polite, everyday)
- ⟦{老女|ろうじょ}→老女：14017_roujo⟧: elderly woman (formal/written)
- ⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧: elderly person (gender-neutral)
